ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity dark pigmentation dominates the central and lower regions of both lobes. High-intensity white mottling and fine-lined patterns are mapped primarily across the upper leading edges and distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees and a distinct depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire boundary, particularly pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to a sharp convex sweep at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast circular white pixels located at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of localized colonization or impact scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel and unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation across both lobes, with a prominent set of parallel lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the entire visible surface; significant localized white scarring and tissue irregularity at the extreme lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular spot located within a high-intensity white patch on the right lobe (image right).
